_comment: Named figure sets for plot_vram.py --set NAME. One entry = one comparison = one output
directory under profiling/results/, with fixed file names, so results stay stable across
re-runs instead of accumulating ad-hoc PNGs. `arms` is also the legend order.
Add a set here rather than passing --arms by hand; a set is the reproducible unit.
`baseline` names the arm `plot_vram.py --set NAME --relative` divides by: the production engine on that set's card.
